text: The cafeteria should introduce the plant-based menu as it provides a reliable and safe way to meet nutritional requirements while offering innovative and sustainable options. The live fermentation station would not only add an exciting element but also align with the campus's commitment to health and sustainability. Moreover, the seasonal produce contract savings offset the new equipment within a year, demonstrating the financial stability and efficiency of the new menu. This move would keep demand steady on North campus and cater to the growing interest in plant-based diets, making it a smart and responsible decision for the cafeteria.
